The third release of Pithagoras, a self-hosted web portal for the [pi coding agent](https://pi.dev). In 0.3.0 subagents are an extension that works in child chats: each subagent is a chat of its own under the chat that asked, under the guard and in the chat's mode, and the agent can list, message, stop and continue them. Extensions can make and run chats of their own, Docker for extensions gives an extension a network with no way out, Voice servers speaks with voices of your own, Media makes new pictures from reference pictures, and voice mode can show an extension's avatar. It covers everything from v0.2.0 on 23 October 2026 up to #345 merged on 28 October 2026, with this release's own pull request: 19 commits and 19 merged pull requests, 6 by @thecodacus and 13 by @Piggidragon.

## Upgrade notes

Read these before deploying over an existing install. The [Upgrading](https://thecodacus.github.io/pithagoras/guide/upgrading#from-0-2-0-to-0-3-0) guide has a section for a portal at 0.2.0, one for each step below, and the steps for going back to 0.2.0.

**The database and the first start**

- **The database goes from schema 11 to 16 in one start.** It is checked, backed up as `backups/portal-v11-<date>-<time>.db`, and upgraded in one transaction, behind the Upgrading page. 0.2.0 does not open the upgraded database: going back is putting that backup back, with the steps in the guide. A portal at 0.1.0 goes from schema 3 to 16 in one start, with 0.2.0's notes as well.
- **The subagent's settings move to its extension** (#322, #326): `subagentMode`, `subagentMaxParallel` and `subagentModel` leave pi's `settings.json` (kept beside it as `settings.json.bak`), and what each chat said its subagents run on leaves the database. The extension takes both up as it starts. A subagent tool that was on stays on.
- **Chats can have a parent** (#323, #327, #339): every existing chat stays one of its own, listed and attended. Nothing needs doing.

**Things to change**

- **Reload open tabs** after the upgrade.
- **The subagent tool is an extension**: switch it in Settings → Extensions and set it up under Extension settings → Subagents. `GET`/`PUT /api/features/subagent` and `/api/sessions/:id/subagent-model` answer with a 307 to the extension's routes; `PUT /api/features/subagent` with `enabled` and `subagent` in `GET /api/features/flags` are gone. A copy of the tool installed by hand from an old clone keeps its settings in pi's file, and the log says so: replace it with the one that comes with the portal.
- **`PI_SUBAGENT_BIN` and `PI_SUBAGENT_GRACE_MS`** are no longer read (#328). No environment variable is new.

**What behaves differently**

- **Subagents run as child chats** (#328), under the guard (and the sandbox, where it is on), held to the chat's tool switches and, by default, in the chat's mode (#330). Something a subagent could do before may now be refused or wait for you. A heartbeat has no `subagent` tool any more.
- **The Subagents panel lists subagents only** (#320): code mode, web search, fetch, deep research and MCP calls are no longer listed there. A dock side or width given to the panel starts at the default once.
- **Docker for extensions 1.3.0** (#315) refuses a container on another extension's network or on one nobody made, and one sharing the network of a container that is neither the extension's nor the portal's. Browser, Voice and Understory are not affected.

## Known issues

- 0.2.0's [known issues](https://github.com/thecodacus/pithagoras/releases/tag/v0.2.0) still hold, #43's macOS part among them.
- **#338:** in the extension API, `chats.prompt` right after `chats.abort` can resolve against the stopped run's end.
- **#336:** a switched-off MCP tool is refused when called, but `mcp` still lists it and its server.

## Subagents

- **An extension of its own** (#322, #326): its settings page, the Subagents panel, a chip in the running tray for each one at work, *Watch* on the call that started one, and the row in the model menu are all the `pithagoras-subagent` extension's.
- **Child chats** (#328): each subagent works in a chat of its own with its own transcript, shown in the panel, with *Open as chat*. With **Keep subagent chats** on, they are listed as sub-chats and the agent continues one by its id.
- **The agent and its subagents** (#321, #329): the tool says how many may run at once, and results say how many run and wait. The agent can message a subagent at work, and list and stop them with the new `subagents` tool.
- **The chat's mode** (#330): a subagent works in the mode of the chat it works for, code mode and your own modes included; **Subagents work in the chat's mode** switches it to Standard, which still never gets a tool the chat's mode switched off.
- **Sub-chats** (#327): listed under their chat in the sidebar, on the Sessions page and on the Agents page, folded until opened, with the chat marked when one of them works or waits for you. Deleting a chat deletes its sub-chats.

## Extensions and the extension API

- **Chats from a server half** (#323, #328, #339): `chats.create` for child chats, `prompt`, `abort`, `remove` and `children`; `chats.start` for a chat of its own in an agent's home or a project; `unattended` chats that ask nobody anything; `tools: "defaults"`; `chats.lastAnswer`, `chats.owner` and `portal.http.person(req)`; `newChats` on `folders.list()`; `portal.chats.useEvents` in the browser half.
- **New slots and pieces** (#308, #326): `voice.avatar`, `chat.tray`, `chat.model.menu`, `head` on `chat.tool.action`, `ui.Transcript`, `ui.TrayChip`, `ui.Ring`, `ui.Shimmer` and `format.elapsed`. The subagent protocol is typed in `@pithagoras/extension-api/server` (#322).
- **`@pithagoras/extension-api` 0.3.0** is published with this release. Nothing of 0.2.0's interface was removed, and `portal.version` stays 1.
- **Subagent protocol:** an extension that runs subagents over it is drawn only while Subagents is on, and `subagent:v1:config` is answered with `{}`, so the chat's choice of model is the extension's own to keep (#322, #326).
- **Docker for extensions 1.3.0** (#315): `networks.create`, `get`, `reach` and `remove` give an extension an internal network with no way out, which only the portal reaches. Needs Docker Engine 28.0 or later.

## Voice and media

- **Avatars from extensions** (#308): an extension can draw the agent in voice mode in place of the orb, chosen per agent under **Shown as** in the Avatar dialog; the orb comes back wherever the avatar cannot be drawn.
- **Custom voices in Voice servers** (#317): designed voices and clones for a self-hosted Breeze-TTS-2 or Chatterbox, through audio.cpp or their own servers. Off until switched on; while off, requests are what they were.
- **Reference pictures in Media** (#334): `generate_image` and the Media page make a new picture with 1–8 reference pictures, through the editing endpoint, starting from noise where Stable Diffusion extra settings are on.

## Fixes

- **Documents** (#340): the markers in a document's margin are placed again when the window's width changes, and a deletion that was cut off no longer takes a new file of the same name for the old one.
- **Browser** (#335): in voice mode the browser's window opens at the side when it is the only one, and in the middle when the conversation or the pictures have the side.

## Deploying

- Pin this release with `PITHAGORAS_VERSION=0.3.0` in the Portainer stack, `git checkout v0.3.0` for docker-compose.yml, or the image `ghcr.io/thecodacus/pithagoras:0.3.0`.
